overall: The AG declined to review the challenges to the September 23, September 30, and October 7, 2013 minutes as untimely, and found no violation for the November 18, 2013 minutes because they were still in draft when the complaint was filed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the minutes of the September 23, September 30, and October 7, 2013 meetings were inaccurate.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed more than 30 days after each of these sets of minutes was approved, we find the allegations concerning these meeting minutes untimely and decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the October 7, 2013 minutes failed to list a particular document used at that meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was filed more than 30 days after each of these sets of minutes was approved, we find the allegations concerning these meeting minutes untimely and decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the November 18, 2013 minutes were inaccurate or insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: Because these minutes remained in draft form at the time of the complaint, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently detailed minutes.
